# Best prestige real estate agencies for a \$10M Adelaide home

For a \$10 million luxury residential property in Adelaide, I would start by interviewing **Booth Real Estate, Fox Real Estate, Alexander Real Estate and TOOP+TOOP**\. These agencies and their leading agents have documented involvement in Adelaide's highest-value residential transactions, including sales above \$10 million.

The key is to appoint an agent who has personally sold homes at your price point, not simply an agency with a premium brand or a large general residential sales team.

Recent market data supports taking this approach: in the 2025–26 financial year, Adelaide recorded a new South Australian residential sales record of **\$15.5 million** for a mansion in Medindie. The city's prestige market now regularly includes transactions above \$10 million. ## What I'd require from each agent before signing

At this price point, the individual agent's performance matters more than the agency's overall sales volume. I'd ask each finalist for the following\:

| What to request | Why it matters |
|--------|--------|
| Three to five comparable settled sales | Look for homes sold for \$8M–\$15M, ideally in the same suburb and of a similar type. |
| Evidence of their personal role | Establish whether they were the lead agent or a supporting agent on the sale. |
| Qualified buyer list | Ask how many buyers can genuinely afford \$10M+ and are actively looking. |
| Off-market strategy | Determine whether they can reach suitable buyers privately before launching publicly. |
| Written marketing plan | Require a tailored proposal for photography, film, editorial coverage, international exposure and buyer outreach. |
| Negotiation and fee proposal | Compare commission, advertising costs, auction fees if applicable, and the plan for handling competing offers. |


For context, a prestige valuation report from Herron Todd White noted in 2026 that some Adelaide luxury sales were occurring off-market through agents' established buyer databases. That makes the quality of an agent's buyer relationships particularly worth testing. [htw.com.au](https://htw.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/HTW-Month-in-Review-Apr-2026_V2_Resi.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[htw.com.au](https://htw.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/HTW-Month-in-Review-Mar-2026-Resi.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommended next step

I'd invite **Jamie Brown at Booth, Nick Pelvay at Fox, and Sally Cameron at TOOP+TOOP** to present competing proposals. Add Alexander Real Estate if your property is a heritage villa or character mansion, and Williams if it suits their core market.

Do not appoint solely on the highest suggested asking price. Ask each agent to justify their expected selling range with actual comparable settlements and explain how they would create competition among qualified buyers.

**One important question\:** What suburb is your \$10 million property in, and is it a contemporary architectural home, a heritage mansion, or a coastal estate? That will help narrow the shortlist to the agents with the most relevant comparable sales.

search_results.title: Morecroft House: East Tce landmark with royal title history for sale
search_results.description: Morecroft House, a historic East Terrace mansion in Adelaide, is now on the market after being home to its current owners for 33 years. Built in 1915 for Elizabeth Bowman, the property once served as a residence for children emigrated from England before being owned by the Department of Health, which led to it being under the title of The Crown. The current owner, Robyn, purchased it from Queen Elizabeth II of Adelaide, noting the property's significant royal connection. Acquired serendipitously after an auction passed it in, Robyn was drawn to its charm and potential. Over the decades, she has preserved its historical features, including Jarrah floors and original signage, while renovating with a minimalist approach to maintain the house’s integrity. Spanning 535sqm across three levels, it includes four bedrooms, expansive living spaces, a library or office, a cellar, and various outdoor entertainment areas. Robyn recounted hosting unique events, including a memorable evening with an opera troupe. She expressed deep appreciation for the home, calling it a humbling, rare experience to live in such a storied residence.

search_results.title: Construction starts on Adelaide apartments One Four Four Hutt
search_results.description: Construction has officially commenced on the One Four Four Hutt apartment development in Adelaide, a joint venture between Fortis and Otello. The 10-storey building, designed by DKO and located on a 1241sqm corner site, will include a mix of one, two, and three-bedroom residences, including a penthouse collection, plus 400sqm of ground-floor retail space. All one-bedroom units have already been sold, with two- and three-bedroom apartments still available starting at $1.125 million and $2.099 million respectively. To date, 19 unconditional sales have been secured, totaling approximately $25.9 million, with an additional four units reserved. Fortis head of development Arthur Dendrinos emphasized the strong demand for premium living in Adelaide, noting this milestone underscores Fortis' long-term commitment to the region. Otello director Daniel Harris highlighted the project's positive impact on the Hutt Street precinct and expressed confidence in the appointed builder, BLAG Commercial, citing a successful previous partnership.

search_results.title: New data reveals SA's most expensive settled sales of 2025/26
search_results.description:
During the 2025/26 financial year, South Australia's top 20 most expensive property settlements totaled over $177 million, with a record-breaking $15.5 million sale of a luxury mansion at 11 The Avenue, Medindie topping the list. The transaction set a new benchmark for residential sales in the state and was brokered by Jamie Brown of Booth Real Estate, marking his fourth time achieving this feat. Brown believes this sale has launched a new $15–$20 million “echelon” of high-end property sales.

Property Edge, which tracks both publicly listed and previously undisclosed sales, reported that other top-selling properties spanned prestigious suburbs and coastal locations like Gilberton, Springfield, and Henley Beach South. The architectural styles ranged from traditional character homes to striking contemporary designs.

Stephanie Williams of Williams Real Estate highlighted a surge in the top-end market, noting the strength of the $7 million to $10 million bracket and rising local demand driven by favorable tax conditions and increased value in prestige residences. While the market was once defined by $3 million listings, prices are now regularly surpassing $10 million, indicating significant growth and buyer confidence in South Australia’s luxury housing market.

search_results.title: Villa Alcyone: Award-winning Elanora mansion eyes suburb record
search_results.description: Villa Alcyone, a Mediterranean-style mansion situated on a steep 890 sqm block at 6 Bicton Ct in Elanora, has entered the market with expectations to surpass the suburb's sales record by millions. Designed by Jayson Pate and built by Resolve Constructions, the award-winning home reflects a growing trend of luxury builders tackling challenging vertical sites. The property garnered multiple accolades at the 2026 HIA Gold Coast and Northern Rivers Awards and a Master Builders Queensland award. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom home spans 579 sqm and features high-end finishes such as Italian marble, dramatic archways, and a Sukabumi stone pool, all inspired by European influences during the owners' travels. Interior design was led by co-owner Helen Foukkare. Positioned to maximize ocean views and offering access to popular nearby beaches like Currumbin and Palm Beach, the mansion is drawing interest from high-end buyers typically focused on more traditionally prestigious areas. Although quarterly data shows a slight dip in Elanora home prices, the suburb's annual values rose 14.7 percent, reflecting its evolving luxury market appeal. The Foukkares are already planning another unique luxury build in the Gold Coast region.

search_results.title: Wealthy Aussie family bears brunt of brutal housing downturn
search_results.description: Australia's luxury property market is experiencing a significant downturn, highlighted by dramatic declines in high-profile home sales. A four-bedroom home in Flinders, Victoria, originally offered at $10.25 million, eventually sold for $7.8 million after 305 days on the market. Similarly, Rothesay, a six-bedroom mansion in Balmain East, Sydney, recently sold for $12.8 million—down nearly 35% from its $19.76 million price in 2022. The owner, businessman Devesh Mishra, had declared bankruptcy following the collapse of his firms, prompting a mortgagee-in-possession sale. Real estate agents cite high interest rates, low buyer inquiries, and financial instability—including inflation and global conflict—as key drivers of the market slump. Experts from Cotality Research and AMP predict property value declines of up to 15%, surpassing earlier forecasts and marking the steepest post-war price fall in Australia. National home values have dropped 5.2% since March, with capital cities like Sydney and Melbourne seeing even steeper declines. Agents suggest deferring property sales until after upcoming elections, hoping for market stabilization.

search_results.title: Hawk star Jarman Impey lists Brighton East home for $2.1m
search_results.description: AFL star Jarman Impey of the Hawthorn Hawks has listed his Brighton East home for sale at $1.95m–$2.1m following a successful footy season. Impey played a key role in helping the Hawks finish fourth and reach the preliminary final in 2026, and was named on the All Australian team. He previously played 75 games for Port Adelaide before moving to Hawthorn in 2018, reaching a total of 169 matches with them. He is also known for his long-standing representation in the Indigenous All-Stars team. The property, located near Dendy Park, features a spacious layout suitable for families or professionals, with four bedrooms, a Miele kitchen, dual living zones, and convenient access to local amenities. Impey attributes the nearby facilities like the athletics track to his maintained fitness, citing its grass surface as ideal for AFL training. Impey and his wife Annabelle hope the next owners enjoy the home as much as they did with their 17-month-old son Zion. The sale is handled by Kay & Burton's Matthew Pillios, who praises the home’s location and lifestyle appeal.

## What I'd require from each agent before signing

At this price point, the individual agent's performance matters more than the agency's overall sales volume. I'd ask each finalist for the following\:

| What to request | Why it matters |
|--------|--------|
| Three to five comparable settled sales | Look for homes sold for \$8M–\$15M, ideally in the same suburb and of a similar type. |
| Evidence of their personal role | Establish whether they were the lead agent or a supporting agent on the sale. |
| Qualified buyer list | Ask how many buyers can genuinely afford \$10M+ and are actively looking. |
| Off-market strategy | Determine whether they can reach suitable buyers privately before launching publicly. |
| Written marketing plan | Require a tailored proposal for photography, film, editorial coverage, international exposure and buyer outreach. |
| Negotiation and fee proposal | Compare commission, advertising costs, auction fees if applicable, and the plan for handling competing offers. |

## My recommended next step

I'd invite **Jamie Brown at Booth, Nick Pelvay at Fox, and Sally Cameron at TOOP+TOOP** to present competing proposals. Add Alexander Real Estate if your property is a heritage villa or character mansion, and Williams if it suits their core market.

Do not appoint solely on the highest suggested asking price. Ask each agent to justify their expected selling range with actual comparable settlements and explain how they would create competition among qualified buyers.

**One important question\:** What suburb is your \$10 million property in, and is it a contemporary architectural home, a heritage mansion, or a coastal estate? That will help narrow the shortlist to the agents with the most relevant comparable sales.
